sloka: शम्बरो देवराजेन नरको विष्णुना यथा।तथा ऽद्य शयिता रामो मया युधि निपातितः ।। ६.६९.७ ।।
transliteration: śambaro devarājena narako viṣṇunā yathā।tathā 'dya śayitā rāmo mayā yudhi nipātitaḥ ।। 6.69.7 ।।

translations.english: "Just as Lord of Devas by Sambara, and Vishnu by Naraka, in the same way Rama will also be destroyed struck by me."
